description: Quote the connected account's exact Gold price for the box model workflow: present an owned image's subject as a boxed collectible. Returns gold_cost, affordable and quote_token without starting a run, moderating, charging Gold or consuming a free sheet. After the user approves the price, call chargen_run_recipe_box_model with the same values and quote_token. For input rules, use chargen_get_recipe_box_model.

sourceImageId.description: Owned still image UUID from chargen_search_gallery
